description: LiveRamp CTV event pixel requires its assigned PID. Optional CTVID must be omitted when absent. IPv6 is supported. Header requirements depend on VAST-wrapper context not conveyed by a standalone request.

params.name: pid
params.description: Account Manager supplies the pixel ID used by this endpoint.

params.name: ctvid
params.description: When the device ID is unavailable, LiveRamp explicitly says to omit the parameter. No UUID grammar is published.
